examples.text: Sie ist seit einiger Zeit schwindsüchtig und wird wohl nicht mehr lange leben.

glosses: Having a tendency to consume; dissipating; destructive; wasteful.

examples.text: [O]n ſome occaſions, he diſplayed all his fund of good humour, vvith a vievv to beguile her ſorrovv; he importuned her to give him the pleasure of ’ſquiring her to ſome place of innocent entertainment; and, finally, inſiſted upon her accepting a pecuniary reinforcement to her finances, vvhich he knevv to be in a moſt conſumptive condition.
The lean, conſumptive, wench, with coughs decay'd, / Is call'd a pretty, tight, and ſlender maid.

glosses: A person suffering from pulmonary tuberculosis.

examples.text: The consumptive has managed to shake the servant from her side and walks alone, striving to make it look easy.
Unter anderem warnte er mich vor allzu eifrigem Studium; denn in der dicken Luft Calabriens könne ich durch zu große geistige Anstrengung leicht schwindsüchtig werden.
examples.translation: Mimo jiné mě varoval před tím, abych se příliš horlivě neoddával studiu; jelikož v parné Kalábrii by mi velká duševní námaha mohla snadno vyvolat souchotiny.

glosses: adj. 患痨病的，患肺结核的
